name: Nakoran
backstory: Child of Prince Doran and Nakus, in Salthos Cruzados; grew up around holds court at the square each morning, hears..., and picked up a little of CONFLICT-02 along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Darius has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Nierius now have a child, Fenrius.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Prince Doran, named Dorakus.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Niemius, named Niemoran.
Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dorukus.

experience: Learned that Prince Doran has died.

experience.text: Had a child with Fenserika, named Nakorika.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to CONFLICT-03
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with CONFLICT-03

routines.routine_actions: takes his turn hearing petitions each morning, refers the harder disputes upward same as his father did, and checks the crossing's quiet himself before dark

arc.premise: Nakoran has stopped just checking the books and started counting what's actually left - leftover timber, unspent coin - laid out and weighed in front of witnesses, so the roof's final cost is settled by what's physically there, not by whoever's arithmetic wins the argument.
